_doc: M6.8-M6.10 (T6.12; D-E and D-F RULED option 1, 2026-10-20; D-066 R2, A2 item 4, A11). The unit-progression CONTENT: promotion trees (M6.9) and the dormant repeatable-training / Action Capacity data (M6.10). Contract: docs/m6-plan/unit-progression-contract.md (promotions) and docs/m6-plan/training-ap-contract.md (training).

INERT. UnitProgressionContentLoader loads and validates this file; NO simulation system, query, order, AI policy or save table reads it (source guard: UnitProgressionInertTests). The only reader outside the tests is the unit card's planned-for-M7 entry (Sim.Ui, display only). Nothing in this build earns experience, holds a promotion or trains a formation: M7 adds the state, the earning rule and the application (unit-progression-contract.md section 5).
Every number is an ILLUSTRATIVE BAND for shape validation, not a tuned value (D-006 TUNE; unit charter section 15.6 calibration not done).

trees: one per group of land ARMY-FORMATION families (D-011 section 3 formation fields exist only for formations). A family belongs to at most one tree. promotions[].effects name a FIELD and a TERM of the M7 contract (unit-progression-contract.md section 3); scale is a coefficient INSIDE that term's resolution equation (Law 2), never a flat bonus. A (field, term) pair is granted by exactly one promotion in the whole file: no stat is duplicated within or across trees. requires: promotion ids of the same tree, acyclic. exclusiveGroup: at most one member of a group can be held; a group has two or more members of one tree. maxTimes: how often a promotion can be taken (1..repeatCap); its compounded coefficient scale^maxTimes stays within the loader's bounds.

training: the D-F contract as data. mode is 'explicit' (an action the owner orders, spending Action Capacity); passiveGainPerYear is 0 - a dormant formation (M7 action state 'idle' for a whole refresh) never improves. Each profile: eligibility (condition names from the contract vocabulary), cost (the share of the refresh's Action Capacity the action consumes, and its duration in sim-years, accrued as a rate x dtYears), increment (max Action Capacity gained per completed training), cap (trainings per carrier), diminishing (the k-th training lasts years x factor^(k-1)). rejections: one per condition, with the reason a refused order states.

promotions.name: Drilled
promotions.description: Practised in changing formation: the formation re-forms its frontage faster.

promotions.name: Steady ranks
promotions.description: Holds together under losses: less cohesion is lost per casualty.

promotions.name: Shock tactics
promotions.description: Closes hard: a larger melee coefficient in the paired engagement. Excludes Shield wall.

promotions.name: Shield wall
promotions.description: Fights in close order: a smaller share of casualties taken. Excludes Shock tactics.

promotions.name: Practised volleys
promotions.description: Repeated practice: a larger ranged-fire coefficient. Can be taken twice.

promotions.name: Fire discipline
promotions.description: Shoots on command: less ammunition spent per volley.

promotions.name: Full pouches
promotions.description: Carries more missiles into battle. Excludes Screening drill.

promotions.name: Screening drill
promotions.description: Turns to face a threat quickly. Excludes Full pouches.

promotions.name: Horse care
promotions.description: Mounts recover faster at rest: a larger fatigue-recovery rate per sim-year.

promotions.name: Rally drill
promotions.description: Re-forms after a charge: a larger cohesion-recovery rate per sim-year.

promotions.name: Hardened riders
promotions.description: Rides longer before tiring: less fatigue per pulse of action. Can be taken twice.

promotions.name: Last to break
promotions.description: Stays in the fight longer: a lower cohesion threshold before rout.

rejections.text: Only the formation's owner can order its training.
Training needs the formation stationed at a settlement its owner controls.
A formation that is re-equipping cannot train until the re-equipment completes or is cancelled.
A formation in battle or under siege cannot train.
An unfed or unsupplied formation cannot train.
Training needs the stated share of this refresh's Action Capacity unspent.
The formation has trained as often as its family allows.
